correctness.rationale: Two independent exhaustive recursions certify the finite statement. Canonical least-unused-vertex recursion enumerates every perfect matching exactly once and reproduces 15!!=2,027,025. Canonical nondecreasing-tuple recursion enumerates every eight-element nonzero difference multiset and XOR-filters exactly 20,295 admissible profiles. Equality of the two profile sets proves existence for every admissible profile; exact tallying gives the histogram, and direct inspection plus the fixed-direction 1-factor proves the unique-profile characterization.
